headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
summary: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

headline: Lamar Jackson Out With High Ankle Sprain
summary: OCTOBER 24: Ahead of tomorrow’s home matchup with the Bengals, the Ravens have officially downgraded Jackson to “out.” The three-time first-team All-Pro passer will miss his third game in a row after sitting out the entire second half of Baltimore’s Week 4 win over the Titans. headline: Texans activate WR Tank Dell to the active roster
summary: Tank Dell will play his first game in nearly two years on Sunday when the Texans play the Giants.

headline: 49ers activate WR Christian Kirk from IR
summary: The 49ers made a procedural move on Friday, releasing defensive lineman Ogbo Okoronkwo to make room for wide receiver Christian Kirk.

headline: Lions activate Brian Branch, Cade Mays
summary: Safety Brian Branch will be back in the Lions' lineup on Sunday afternoon.

headline: Giants CB Paulson Adebo Activated Off IR
summary: The Giants will get some much-needed reinforcement in their secondary this weekend. According to Dan Duggan of The Athletic, one of New York’s five cornerbacks on injured reserve has been activated, and that cornerback is starter Paulson Adebo.
